strongs_1890.strongs_def: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
strongs_1890.derivation: plural (but always as singular) of an unused noun פָּנֶה; from H6437 (פָּנָה));
